description: Get a shareable report URL and the embeddable "Audited by Website Auditor" badge snippet for a website. Use this when someone wants to "share," "export," "send a client," or "embed" the audit result. Returns a link and an HTML badge snippet. Requires a Website Auditor subscription ($10/month; eligible new customers get a 7-day free trial — payment method required, no charge until the trial ends) — if the user doesn't have one, call get_sample_audit first to show them the exact output format, free and with no API key.
name: get_report
title: Shareable report + badge
